properties.current: 1-based index of the only Process item

behavior.continuity: Items before the only Process item are Finished; following items are Wait.
behavior.navigation: Finished items are clickable only when the business permits review or backward navigation.
behavior.connector: Outgoing line of finished = Border/focused; outgoing line of process/wait = Border/secondary. End item has no outgoing line; end+process incoming = Border/focused.

constraints: Exactly one Process item at a time.
Failure belongs in step content with recovery, not as Wait color.
Narrow layouts scroll rather than overlap items.
Title is 中文/S4-CN-S 16/24, not the old 18/26 rule.
Serial finished keeps a solid Text/blue circle and the number; it is not an outline and not a check icon.
End position: Figma serial only publishes process (not finished). Runtime last-step finished uses that same visual.
Full-width page usage insets start/end by 48px (Interval/space10), not 0 and not the 264-cell 118px start/end padding.
Serial/Dot indicator, title and description share one horizontal center axis. Do not left-align start or right-align end.

confirmedDecisions.decision: progress_item/serial 末项只保留 process。原 end+finished（4493:9032）已改名为 end+process。末项没有出向连接线，process 与 finished 视觉相同，实现里最后一步 finished 映射到同一视觉。
indicator_serial 只发布 wait / progress。finished 指示器复用 progress 实心蓝圆与序号，不再单独出态。
confirmedDecisions.source: 用户设计确认（process 与 finished 视觉相同，只保留一个）

confirmedDecisions.decision: 页面全宽步骤条两侧各留 48px（40–60 的确认取值，Interval/space10）。指示器与标题、说明必须居中对齐；禁止首尾贴边或把 start/end 改成左/右对齐。组件规范页仍按 264 单元展示。这是页面组合规则，不是 Figma 264 单元格的 start 118px 内边距。
